description: This script fetches discussions from a GitHub repository, analyzes commenters and authors over various timeframes, and updates a YAML file with the results. It also automates creating a pull request with the updated data.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub discussion author with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: CommentsNode
classes.description: Represents a comment node with creation time and author.

classes.name: Replies
classes.description: Contains total count and list of reply comments.

classes.name: DiscussionsNode
classes.description: Represents a discussion with metadata and comments.

classes.name: DiscussionsEdge
classes.description: An edge in the discussions GraphQL response, containing a cursor and a discussion node.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponseData
classes.description: Wrapper for discussions data in GraphQL response.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Top-level GraphQL response structure for discussions.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings including GitHub token, repository, and request parameters.

classes.name: DiscussionExpertsResults
classes.description: Holds counters of commenters and authors over various timeframes.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Performs a GraphQL request to GitHub API and returns the data, handling errors.

methods.name: get_graphql_question_discussion_edges
methods.description: Fetches discussion edges from GitHub GraphQL API for a specific category.

methods.name: get_discussion_nodes
methods.description: Retrieves all discussion nodes by paginating through discussion edges.

methods.name: get_discussions_experts
methods.description: Analyzes discussion nodes to count commenters and authors over different timeframes.

methods.name: get_top_users
methods.description: Returns a list of top users based on comment counts, excluding skipped users.

methods.name: get_users_to_write
methods.description: Prepares a list of users with counts and author info for output.

methods.name: update_content
methods.description: Updates a YAML file with new content if it has changed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching discussions, analyzing, updating YAML, and creating a PR.
